svg.aria-label: A gallery wall of framed memories mixed with colourful spirals, woven discs and small prints: the FYP team at the National Cyber Security Academy, a trio of friends under the trees, a convocation day, Effa with her siblings in the garden, two friends on a campus bench, society event preparation, friends on the Air University steps, the society team with a big photo frame prop, and library study sessions, above a ledge with a plant, vases and candles
